cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: The name of the class that can build a Decision Tree Regression model in Scikit-learn is called DecisionTreeRegressor.
cues.zh: scikit-learn 中能建立決策樹迴歸模型的類別，叫做 DecisionTreeRegressor。

cues.en: It is a class that belongs to the tree module of Scikit-learn, and therefore, here we're gonna start from Scikit-learn
cues.zh: 它屬於 scikit-learn 的 tree 模組，因此先從 sklearn

cues.en: from which we're gonna call that tree module.
cues.zh: 存取 tree 模組。

cues.en: And from which we're going to import that decision, Google Colab will guess it.
cues.zh: 再匯入 DecisionTreeRegressor，Google Colab 會自動提示。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 出現了。

cues.en: So be careful it's not DecisionTreeClassifier, that will be for part three classification, but DecisionTreeRegressor.
cues.zh: 注意，不是 DecisionTreeClassifier，那是第三部分分類要用的；這裡是 DecisionTreeRegressor。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: This is based on the same model, decision trees, but DecisionTreeRegressor will predict a continuous numerical value and decision tree classification will predict the category.
cues.zh: 兩者都基於決策樹，但 DecisionTreeRegressor 預測連續數值，決策樹分類則預測類別。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then the next natural step here is of course to create an object or an instance of that DecisionTreeRegressor class, and we're gonna call that, as usual, regressor.
cues.zh: 下一步自然是建立 DecisionTreeRegressor 的物件或實例，一樣命名為 regressor。

cues.en: Which will be equal, of course, to the call of this class.
cues.zh: 將它設為呼叫這個類別的結果。

cues.en: So I'm copying this and pasting that right here, and adding some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 複製名稱，貼到這裡，再加括號。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So now question is, do we have to input anything here in the parenthesis?
cues.zh: 問題是，括號裡需要填什麼嗎？

cues.en: Well, actually no.
cues.zh: 其實不用。

cues.en: You know, there are not many parameters to tune in the Decision Tree Regression model.
cues.zh: 決策樹迴歸模型沒有太多必須調整的參數。

cues.en: I don't recommend to spend too much time tuning it and just to try it among your other regression models.
cues.zh: 我不建議花太多時間調整，先和其他迴歸模型一起試用。

cues.en: But if you really want to tune it, please note that there is this part 10 of the course which covers all the techniques of parameter tuning, which allows you to improve and optimize the performance
cues.zh: 若確實想調參，課程第十部分涵蓋各種參數調整技術，可改善並最佳化單一模型的

cues.en: of a single model.
cues.zh: 效能。

cues.en: And so don't worry, you will know how to deploy these techniques to enhance a model.
cues.zh: 別擔心，你會知道如何使用這些技巧提升模型。

cues.en: But here, we just want to learn how to build and train the Decision Tree Regression model and therefore we will only input one parameter but which is just for training purposes,
cues.zh: 這裡先學建立與訓練決策樹迴歸，所以只填入一個參數，而且只是為了教學，

cues.en: it is, you know, that random state parameter, which will allow us to get the same result in the end.
cues.zh: 也就是 random_state，讓最後的結果相同。

cues.en: Because indeed, there are some random factors happening when you build and train your DecisionTreeRegressor, and therefore, if we don't fix the seed, we will get slightly different results at the end.
cues.zh: 建立與訓練 DecisionTreeRegressor 時有隨機因素；如果不固定種子，最後會得到略有不同的結果。

cues.en: And you know, it's nicer to have the same results so that we can all be on the same page.
cues.zh: 大家結果一致，才能一起對照，會更方便。

cues.en: So we're just going to input random_state parameter,
cues.zh: 所以只填入 random_state，

cues.en: and set that equal to zero, right?
cues.zh: 設為 0。

cues.en: We're fixing the seed here with that zero value for the random_state parameter.
cues.zh: 用 random_state=0 固定亂數種子。

cues.en: And now final step, well you totally know how to finish this, we just need to take our regressor and then call the fit method,
cues.zh: 最後一步你一定知道：使用 regressor，呼叫 fit，

cues.en: which takes this input, of course, the matrix of features X, the whole matrix, and then the dependent variable vector Y.
cues.zh: 傳入完整特徵矩陣 X，以及應變數向量 y。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So this will actually train your DecisionTreeRegressor to understand the correlations between the position levels here and the salaries.
cues.zh: 這樣會訓練 DecisionTreeRegressor，了解職等與薪資之間的關聯。

cues.en: After which, you will have a trained model which you will be able to deploy in production to predict a new result, and especially that salary of the position level 6.5.
cues.zh: 訓練完成後，就可以部署模型來預測新結果，尤其是職等 6.5 的薪資。
